verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible capability for a real-time communications SDK and platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence covers only messaging, audio, video, screen sharing, data messages and PSTN/SIP features, with no AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The llms.txt and markdown docs probes are documentation-access features for external tools, not an in-product assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
